nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Invisible+ Daytime Hydrocolloid Acne Pimple Patches

segments.oily: One reviewer with very oily skin says the patches help draw out excess oil quickly while the pimple heals underneath.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer who scars easily reports the patch left a darkened scar on treated pimples while an untreated control pimple healed without a trace; another with acne-prone skin reports no irritation at all.
segments.normal: One reviewer states the product worked for their skin and describes it as suited to all skin types with no issues noted.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers describe visible reduction or disappearance of surfaced pimples and whiteheads within one to three days, often overnight; a few note the patch works best only once the pimple has a visible head and is less effective on pimples still below the skin surface.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report the patches pull out pus, gunk and blackheads and speed healing of active breakouts, including hormonal and body acne; two reviewers rate the effect as weaker than the original (non-invisible) patch.
concerns.aging: Two reviewers mention using or wanting to use a version for fine lines and wrinkles, with one saying it worked well for wrinkles and another simply expressing interest in trying that use, so this is anecdotal rather than a core reported benefit.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the patch helps absorb excess oil around the treated area.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports scarring and new breakouts appearing where the patch was used, describing skin as easily scarred; most other reviewers who mention scarring say the patch reduced or prevented it by stopping them from picking.

extraits.texte: Be cautious if you scar easily like me. The few zits I applied these to, I am left with a darkened scar. I did not use it on other zits that I had at the same time to compare the difference. The control zits are completely gone, no trace. The 'treated' zits using this thing are scarred, darkened, and new zits are popping up. Wish I saved my money and my skin. Extremely regretful purchase.
I feel I use these everyday to keep my acne at bay. I have very oily skin too so it helps to get out excess oil fast and clean while your pimple is still healing internally as well

Love all Hero products, but especially the Mighty Patches. Both the regular & invisible are fantastic at pulling out the gunk in any pimple that is starting. Sometimes it will take 2 or 3 nights of patches to get it all, but much better than letting one fester & just get worse. Not a fan of the all over face patches - seemed to start an epic breakout.
It works mostly well, but the pimple has to have a head to be effective. Occasionally the patch rips off the head, but it is a good product.

I love Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Invisible! It works to absorb oil and improve the look of pores! The patch is flexible and thin! Its designed to get in the creases also! There wasn't any irritation after using either!

I absolutely love Mighty Patch Invisible+. They are super effective for helping breakouts disappear quicker and help to prevent scarring. I love that I can wear these during the day and they are not noticeable. I can't wait to try the patch for fine lines and wrinkles.

I love these little patches. I have used them during both day and night and I truly feel like they really do work. Usually after getting my eyebrows waced I have a massive breakout, but wearing these patches overnight prevented that! The only con is that they do leave a very obvious circle imprint on your skin that takes nearly a day to go away.
